notes: Two borderline items were left unflagged. /accessibility/0 recommends naming the list with accessibilityLabel. That holds on the web, but the evidence says iOS probably never announces the list's name, since the native list is accessible={false} (not checked on a device). A reviewer may want that caveat added. /content/rules/4 is marked required on the strength of the guide's own "never a sentence". That reading is defensible because the sentence covers every value, but its doDont counterpart (/content/rules/9) is only discouraged.
